text: The Patriots are riding genuine momentum after Drake Maye's exceptional performance in last Sunday's 29-26 upset victory over the Bills—a win so pivotal that Mike Vrabel singled it out as critical for the defending AFC East champions—with the quarterback earning AFC Offensive Player of the Week honors for his three-touchdown display that snapped his early-season struggles. However, the celebration is tempered by the looming question mark at running back, where Rhamondre Stevenson's injury has forced the team to reconsider their backfield depth heading into this week's matchup against Las Vegas. The Raiders present a formidable challenge with their dangerous 1-2 tight end combination of Brock Bowers and Michael Mayer—a pairing that poses a far different defensive puzzle than the Patriots faced in Week 4, when they successfully neutralized Buffalo's hot-hand Dalton Kincaid. With the Patriots now sitting at 2-2 after their dramatic comeback win, Sunday's 1 PM ET game at Gillette Stadium against another struggling Vegas team offers an opportunity to build on newfound momentum and quiet any lingering doubts about their season trajectory.
